name: Dream Change: Kokin-chan no Fashion Party
original_name: ドリームチェンジ 小金ちゃんのファッションパーティー
source: The game follows a young girl who dreams of becoming a fashion model named Kokin, working to make her dreams come true. This game for the Casio Loopy is a modeling simulator.
translation: 游戏讲述了一个名叫Kokin的年轻女孩梦想成为一名时装模特，并努力实现她的梦想。这款卡西欧Loopy游戏是一款建模模拟器。
